question: As per India's Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011, the total households in the country (Rural plus Urban) was ________ crores.
solution:
The correct answer is __**24.49 crores**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Socio Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011**, the total number of households in India (including both rural and urban areas) was recorded at **24.49 crores**.
 
• The SECC 2011 is a significant survey conducted by the Government of India to gather comprehensive data on the socio-economic status of households across the country.
 
• This figure of **24.49 crore households** provides crucial data for planning and implementing various government schemes and policies aimed at improving the living conditions of citizens.
 
• The SECC data captures multiple dimensions such as poverty, housing, education, and employment, making it a vital tool for targeted welfare measures.
 
• The census is jointly conducted by the **Ministry of Rural Development**, the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**, and the **Registrar General of India** to ensure accurate and reliable data collection.
